cases.architecture: Hono 4 on Cloudflare Workers: D1 holds the usage ledger and quota rows, a KV namespace holds the hot per-period counters and an R2 bucket holds generated exports; the caller is an API key resolved from the Authorization header by the apiKeyAuth middleware in src/middleware/apiKey.ts and read off the Hono context.
cases.why: The `metric` and `customer_id` query parameters are concatenated into the WHERE clause of the report statement as single-quoted SQL literals and the assembled string is handed to D1's prepare(), while the date window beside them travels as a bound parameter. A value such as ' OR '1'='1 closes the literal and rewrites the predicate, so the account_id filter the comment relies on can be neutralised and any tenant's usage_events read back through the report.
